color.note: Graphite with a cool blue-teal bias and one signal colour. Dark is the hero theme and comes first.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything; the ground of the goggle view.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables and the chart plot area, on page.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, tooltips and the hovered table row; the only raised layer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between rows, under the nav, around panels and as chart gridlines. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (fields, secondary buttons, checkboxes) and the chart axis. At least 3:1 on page, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on page, surface, surface-raised and every -soft fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, timestamps, table headers, axis ticks, empty and loading lines. On page, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: OSD cyan, the one accent: primary button fill, focus ring and reticle brackets, the live dot, links on hover. As text on page, surface, surface-raised and signal-soft.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind signal text: the live pill, the active scan line.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and figures on a signal fill: the primary button label, the unread count.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: A deal: price dropped, new cheapest listing, a same-product verdict. As text on page, surface, surface-raised and good-soft.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind good text in pills and the price-drop delta chip.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: OSD low-battery amber: stale listings, backing off, a plugin warning. As text on page, surface, surface-raised and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text in pills and warning notices.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Failed, disabled, config invalid, refusals and field errors; the danger button fill. As text on page, surface, surface-raised and critical-soft.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an error notice.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text on a critical fill: the danger button label and the failed pill.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral facts that are not a deal or a problem: the variant verdict, a settings-applied note. As text on page, surface, surface-raised and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind info text.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a modal dialog (Confirm).

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (cyan): the first listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Also the sparkline stroke. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 (orange): the second listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 (violet): the third listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4 (amber): the fourth listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Chart series 5 (magenta): the fifth listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Chart series 6 (green): the sixth listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Chart series 7 (blue): the seventh listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Chart series 8 (red): the eighth listing in a price-history chart, assigned in this order and never cycled. Marks only (lines, dots, legend swatches), never text. At least 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Horizontal gridlines in a chart; an alias of line.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Chart axis lines and tick marks; an alias of line-strong.

tokens.name: model-bell
tokens.usage: A 3D model: anodised outer casings.

tokens.name: model-base
tokens.usage: A 3D model: dark mounting metal.

tokens.name: model-steel
tokens.usage: A 3D model: bright steel such as shafts, bearings and nuts.

tokens.name: model-steel-dark
tokens.usage: A 3D model: shaded steel such as clips and shields.

tokens.name: model-lamination
tokens.usage: A 3D model: laminated iron cores.

tokens.name: model-copper
tokens.usage: A 3D model: copper windings.

tokens.name: model-nylon
tokens.usage: A 3D model: nylon inserts.

tokens.name: model-north
tokens.usage: A 3D model: a magnet's north pole. Never a status or chart series.

tokens.name: model-south
tokens.usage: A 3D model: a magnet's south pole. Never a status or chart series.

tokens.name: model-phase-a
tokens.usage: A 3D model: the first motor phase, its wire and its coils when lit.

tokens.name: model-phase-b
tokens.usage: A 3D model: the second motor phase, its wire and its coils when lit.

tokens.name: model-phase-c
tokens.usage: A 3D model: the third motor phase, its wire and its coils when lit.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for words: headings, labels, body, buttons.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section h2: Listings, Price history, Add a listing, a product group in Matches.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Stop watching TBS Source One V5? Its price history is kept.
styles.usage: Everything that is a sentence: notices, questions, verdict reasons, status lines.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button labels, nav items and field labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Enter a whole number of hours, at least 1.
styles.usage: Field hints and errors, the not-charted note, tooltip lines.

groups.name: Readout
groups.note: Martian Mono at 87.5% width with tabular, slashed-zero figures, for anything a person compares digit by digit.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: A headline price: the cheapest landed cost on a product.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Every price, shipping cost, landed cost, count, percentage and similarity in a row.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase OSD labels: table headers, pill text, panel titles, the legend. Always uppercase, never a sentence.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Plugin ids, error kinds, file names, domains.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph to label inside a pill; label to control.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a group; table cell vertical padding; between alert rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding; control horizontal padding; gaps in a toolbar row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page gutter; between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a screen; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen (Listings, Price history, Add a listing).

radius.note: Crisp. Nothing rounder than 4px; no pills.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Tables, rules, chart plot, brackets.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, checkboxes, badges.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Panels, notices, the dialog, tooltips.

shadow.note: One elevation, for the dialog only. Everything else separates by hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: The Confirm dialog, nothing else.

size.note: Fixed measures for the reticle and for row rhythm.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and border.

tokens.name: bracket-arm
tokens.usage: Length of each arm of a reticle corner bracket.

tokens.name: bracket-stroke
tokens.usage: Thickness of a reticle bracket and of the focus outline.

tokens.name: bracket-gap
tokens.usage: How far a bracket and the focus outline sit outside the element.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields and selects.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Minimum table row and alert row height.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the nav and main column.
